headline: Keep student records in one place.
linkedin:
I put together Student Management System as a browser-based dashboard to see how academic records, attendance, and grades can be viewed in one place.

This is strictly a local demo using sample data, not a production service intended for actual student information. You can test out the interface directly in the browser or check out the implementation on GitHub.

Demo: https://sourav-bwn.github.io/student-manage-system/
Code: https://github.com/sourav-bwn/student-manage-system
